# Do not edit this file

**Copy it first.** In Cursor: right-click this file in the file list → **Duplicate** (or copy/paste), then rename the copy to `your-github-username.md` in this same `hello/` folder.

Example: if your GitHub username is `alexokscin-trmb`, your new file is `hello/alexokscin-trmb.md`.

Do not change this template. Do not edit anyone else’s file. Your pull request should **add one new file** named after your GitHub username.
